unitTitle: Adjectives/Order of Adjectives/Comparisons - Expressing Certainty - Will
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 3-UNIT MAShQLAR, 4-BET (18-bet, PDF 17). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '3'.

CHAP USTUN:
11) 'Fill in the gaps with must or can't.' 1 A: What's that noise? B: It ...... be the cat outside. 2 A: That will be £5, please. B: It ...... be £5. I only had a cup of coffee! 3 A: Peter's coming home tomorrow. B: He ...... be. He only left for Hong Kong this morning! 4 A: Mum, there's someone at the door. B: Oh, it ...... be Aunt Mary. She's going to help me make some bread. 5 A: Gosh, I'm so tired. B: You ...... be tired. You just woke up. 6 A: Look at that man with the broken arm. B: He ...... be in a lot of pain. 7 A: Mrs Samson always has beautiful roses in her garden. B: Yes. She ...... be a very good gardener. 8 A: The cake is ready. B: It ...... be! I only put it in the oven ten minutes ago. 9 A: Amy graduated from university. B: Oh, that's wonderful. You ...... be very proud of her. 10 A: Glen's driving his father's car. B: He ...... be. He doesn't know how to drive.
'Will (predictions)':
12) 'Look at the chart below and answer questions about each person's future, as in the example.' JADVAL (Mary, Pete, Anne, Bob, Sue, Tom, Jane): be a famous chef - Pete ✓; buy a cottage by the sea - Sue ✓; write science-fiction books - Anne ✓; have three daughters - Bob ✓; live in a flat in the city centre - Mary ✓; become a painter - Tom ✓; study Art - Jane ✓.

O'NG USTUN:
1 A: Will Mary live on a farm? B: No, she won't. She will live in a flat in the city centre. 2 A: Will Pete be a mechanic? B: ...... 3 A: Will Anne write poetry? B: ...... 4 A: Will Bob have two sons? B: ...... 5 A: Will Sue buy a house in the mountains? B: ...... 6 A: Will Tom become a professional basketball player? B: ...... 7 A: Will Jane study medicine? B: ......
13) 'What do you think will/won't happen to you in five years' time? Write sentences, as in the example.' SURAT: kelajak - kosmosdagi robot/odam (fantastik rasm). I will move to the countryside. I won't wear glasses.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '18'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with must or can't.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni must yoki can't bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUST (bo'lsa kerak) / CAN'T
  (bo'lishi mumkin emas) - DALILGA
  QARANG.

  1 MUST be the cat (mantiqiy)
  2 CAN'T be £5 - faqat bir
    piyola qahva ichdim
  3 CAN'T be - bugun ertalab
    Gonkongga ketdi
  4 MUST be Aunt Mary - u kelishi
    kerak edi
  5 CAN'T be tired - endigina
    uyg'onding
  6 MUST be in pain - qo'li singan
  7 MUST be a good gardener -
    gullari chiroyli
  8 CAN'T be ready - 10 daqiqa
    oldin qo'ydim
  9 MUST be proud - universitetni
    bitirdi
  10 CAN'T be - haydashni bilmaydi


⚠ 'GOSH':

  = voy (hayrat).


⚠ 'TO GRADUATE FROM':

  = ... ni bitirmoq.

items.textEn: A: What's that noise? B: It ___ be the cat outside.
A: That will be £5, please. B: It ___ be £5. I only had a cup of coffee!
items.whyUz: ⚠ Bir piyola qahva 5 funt bo'lishi mumkin emas.

items.textEn: A: Peter's coming home tomorrow. B: He ___ be. He only left for Hong Kong this morning!
items.whyUz: ⚠ Bugun ketdi - ertaga qaytishi mumkin emas.

items.textEn: A: Mum, there's someone at the door. B: Oh, it ___ be Aunt Mary. She's going to help me make some bread.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Meri xola kelishi kerak edi → must.

items.textEn: A: Gosh, I'm so tired. B: You ___ be tired. You just woke up.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Endigina uyg'ondi - charchagan bo'lishi mumkin emas.

items.textEn: A: Look at that man with the broken arm. B: He ___ be in a lot of pain.
A: Mrs Samson always has beautiful roses in her garden. B: Yes. She ___ be a very good gardener.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Chiroyli gullar → yaxshi bog'bon bo'lsa kerak.

items.textEn: A: The cake is ready. B: It ___ be! I only put it in the oven ten minutes ago.
A: Amy graduated from university. B: Oh, that's wonderful. You ___ be very proud of her.
A: Glen's driving his father's car. B: He ___ be. He doesn't know how to drive.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the chart below and answer questions about each person's future, as in the example. Chart: Pete - be a famous chef; Sue - buy a cottage by the sea; Anne - write science-fiction books; Bob - have three daughters; Mary - live in a flat in the city centre; Tom - become a painter; Jane - study Art. 1 Will Mary live on a farm? 2 Will Pete be a mechanic? 3 Will Anne write poetry? 4 Will Bob have two sons? 5 Will Sue buy a house in the mountains? 6 Will Tom become a professional basketball player? 7 Will Jane study medicine?
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang va har bir kishining kelajagi haqidagi savollarga javob bering, namunadagidek. Jadval: Pit - mashhur oshpaz bo'lish; Syu - dengiz bo'yida uy sotib olish; Enn - ilmiy-fantastik kitoblar yozish; Bob - uch qizi bo'lish; Meri - shahar markazida kvartirada yashash; Tom - rassom bo'lish; Jeyn - san'at o'qish. 1 Meri fermada yashaydimi? 2 Pit mexanik bo'ladimi? 3 Enn she'r yozadimi? 4 Bobning ikki o'g'li bo'ladimi? 5 Syu tog'da uy sotib oladimi? 6 Tom professional basketbolchi bo'ladimi? 7 Jeyn tibbiyot o'qiydimi?
exercises.explanationUz:
WILL - SAVOL VA INKOR.

  A: Will + kim + fe'l?
  B: No, ... WON'T. ... WILL +
     jadvaldagi haqiqat.

  Hamma savol jadvalga zid → hamma
  javob 'No, ... won't'.


⚠ 'WON'T' = will not.


⚠ 'A COTTAGE':

  = kichik qishloq uyi.


⚠ 'POETRY':

  = she'riyat.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 A: Will Mary live on a farm? B: No, she won't. She will live in a flat in the city centre.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 A: Meri fermada yashaydimi? B: Yo'q. U shahar markazida kvartirada yashaydi.
modelAnswers: 1 No, she won't. She will live in a flat in the city centre.
2 No, he won't. He will be a famous chef.
3 No, she won't. She will write science-fiction books.
4 No, he won't. He will have three daughters.
5 No, she won't. She will buy a cottage by the sea.
6 No, he won't. He will become a painter.
7 No, she won't. She will study Art.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Yo'q. U shahar markazida kvartirada yashaydi. (NAMUNA)
5 Yo'q. U dengiz bo'yida uy sotib oladi.

exercises.instructionEn: What do you think will/won't happen to you in five years' time? Write sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Sizningcha, besh yildan keyin sizga nima bo'ladi / bo'lmaydi? Namunadagidek gaplar yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'Z KELAJAGIM - WILL / WON'T.

  I will + ... (bo'ladi)
  I won't + ... (bo'lmaydi)

  ⚠ 'in five years' time' = besh
  yildan keyin.

  SURAT: fantastik kelajak -
  kosmos va robot.
exercises.exampleEn: I will move to the countryside. I won't wear glasses.
exercises.exampleUz: Men qishloqqa ko'chaman. Men ko'zoynak taqmayman.
modelAnswers: I will move to the countryside. I won't wear glasses.
I will have a good job.
I will speak English very well.
I won't live with my parents.
I will travel to many countries.

patterns.formula: It must be ... (dalil bor) / It can't be ... (dalil qarshi)
patterns.exampleEn: It must be the cat outside. It can't be £5. I only had a cup of coffee!
patterns.exampleUz: Tashqaridagi mushuk bo'lsa kerak. 5 funt bo'lishi mumkin emas. Faqat bir piyola qahva ichdim!

patterns.formula: Will + KIM + FE'L? — No, ... won't. ... will + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Will Pete be a mechanic? — No, he won't. He will be a famous chef.
patterns.exampleUz: Pit mexanik bo'ladimi? — Yo'q. U mashhur oshpaz bo'ladi.

patterns.formula: I will / won't + FE'L + in five years' time
patterns.exampleEn: I will move to the countryside. I won't wear glasses.
